title: Carry forward missing components in color-mix()
author: ybai08
summary: Implements css-color-4 §13.3 carry-forward of `none` components when a color-mix() input is converted to the interpolation space (analogous-component table plus the 'remaining set' rule). Spec-correct, well tested, raises a WPT subset from 48 to 101 passing; worth a review, but `none` inside cross-space color-mix() is rare in real CSS.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI: `color-mix(in hsl, lch(none none 180), hsl(11 33 44))` -> `#4b2d26`; PR/browsers expect `#95594b`, so the bug is still on master. No competing PR for #1368. No comments/reviews. Review notes: adds a required method `set_missing_components` to the public `pub trait Interpolate` (Rust API break for external implementors; give it a default impl), and adds a `ColorSpace` bound on `CssColor::interpolate`. Issue and PR look agent-generated (fringe case).
